svg.desc: Follow the numbered connectors. Subnumbers identify branches or smaller steps. Optional actions and supporting relationships are labeled separately. The usual journey for a question that needs database data: ask in plain language, prepare a database query, read matching data, and return an answer with a table. Other diagrams explain direct answers, errors, and optional features.
svg.title: From your question to an answer

g.text: You ask a question in plain
You receive an answer and a result
